COUNT(email) excludes NULL values; COUNT(*) counts all rows. That's the 20-row gap.

This is SQL standard behavior: aggregate functions like COUNT skip NULLs in specific columns, but COUNT(*) counts row existence regardless of content. No view or hidden filter—it's the function's design.
